//: Config for hosting chifbay.com on Vercel instead of GitHub Pages.
This file is INERT until the domain is actually pointed at Vercel — it is
safe to have in the repo while still on GitHub Pages, which ignores it.
What moving here actually buys, and what it does not:
DOES  turn /about/ and /experiences/ into real 308 redirects instead of
a 404 that JavaScript repairs. Google follows a 308 and passes
link equity; it does not pass equity through a client-side
DOES  give a faster edge CDN, which helps Core Web Vitals slightly.
NOT   improve rankings by virtue of being Vercel. The host is not a
ranking signal. Position for 'chifbay' is an authority problem
(Tripadvisor and Instagram outrank the site), not a hosting one.
NOT   remove the need for 404.html. Vercel is case-sensitive too, so
/About.html still falls through to the client-side recovery.
The GitHub push-to-deploy flow is unaffected: the blog bot and the reviews
sync keep pushing to main, and Vercel builds from the same repo.
